meaning_of_semantic_loss: Spatial depth-error weighting for small anatomical regions, not joint-Z equals surface-Z and not merely a keypoint auxiliary head.

encoder.depth_feature_normalization: Must match the cloud parent decoder exactly; verify all-tap and head-output parity before training.

heads.depth_mask: Load the matched frozen-release H EMA head, retaining its architecture and output semantics.
heads.keypoints: Load a head fitted on the SAME release encoder (H0), not silently the UX adapted-encoder head. If unavailable, fit on TRAIN with release frozen and save/pin one common initialization.
heads.head_learning_rates: Copy each task's existing preregistered parent head schedule into the cloud binding; do not guess new rates.

depth_parent.default: anchor0.3 + plane0.3; otherwise freeze the final cloud light/heavy decision before any comparison
depth_parent.global_scale_alignment: One original full-support per-view gauge only; never align each part separately.

part_balance.tail_ears: Enable only with a pre-output registered semantic mapping and reliable visible TRAIN support; absence stays missing and is reported, not silently synthesised.
part_balance.roi_source: Frozen TRAIN-visible 2D labels or independently defined synthetic part support, intersected with target depth validity/confidence; never the student's current predicted mask.
part_balance.missing_support: Keep the complete sample and original depth loss; part reduction falls back to baseline. Report per-source/view/part availability and cap saturation.
part_balance.pseudo_depth_limit: ROI weighting cannot create missing toe/tail geometry or turn a visual hull into accurate local surface truth.
part_balance.nondecomposable_parent_loss: Keep the cloud global SILog exactly; add returned focus_loss from nonnegative SmoothL1 log-depth residuals under the same original full-support gauge. strength is already inside focus_loss; do not multiply it twice. OFF strength0 adds exactly0. The cap bounds the auxiliary error-map weights, not the total network gradient of SILog+anchor+plane.

schedule.joint_update: One depth and one keypoint microbatch, gradients accumulated then one shared optimizer step; same 12000 depth updates as D arms.
schedule.task_gradient_diagnostic: Measure both task encoder norms/cosines on fixed TRAIN batches before the formal arms; if units make fixed1:1 unusable, preregister ONE common TRAIN-only coefficient for J0/J1 before either run. No per-arm or DEV-driven tuning.
schedule.domain_reduction: Preserve parent per-domain averaging/weights; do not pool pixels across sources or double depth updates for a joint arm.
schedule.encoder_ramp: Preserve the cloud protected ramp over the first sixth and all exclusions (including masked biases).

primary: per-part metric depth median and P90 in mm
valid/total landmark support and failure counts
secondary: raw and globally aligned whole-body depth
evaluation.retention: Keep the cloud parent synthetic20% guard and all existing per-domain/view keypoint regression gates; separately report raw metric scale, no oracle-scale deployment claim.
evaluation.selection: Fixed EMA endpoints, no best-step picking. Start matched seed17 controls, then preregistered complete29/43 confirmation for a candidate. Report paired seed/session results; changes~0.001 aligned may be noise.

boundaries.gauge_only_landmarks: The205 own-rig evaluation moments must not be recruited to ROI training, teacher fitting or joint losses. Join only independently admitted TRAIN items.
boundaries.old_automations: Remain paused; this source publication does not restart them.
